uart_tx.description: 8N1, LSB first; 16 core ticks/bit; TX FIFO stream

uart_rx.description: 8N1 receiver, 16 ticks/bit; samples 1.5 bits after synchronized start; bad stop sets event1 and halts

spi_mode0.description: Mode0 MSB-first full duplex, one CS pulse per byte, 18 ticks/bit; TX in / RX out

i2c_write.description: Single-controller write: TX count-minus-one then address/data bytes; RX one ACK bit/byte (0 ACK, 1 NACK); aborts on NACK; START/STOP and stretch-aware SCL

i2c_read.description: Single-controller read: TX read-count-minus-one then address byte with R/W=1; RX address ACK followed by data; controller ACKs all except final byte (NACK), aborts address NACK

edge_capture.description: Wait for low then rising input; capture synchronized pads/cycle count, broadcast event0

event_pulse.description: Wait/consume event0, emit nine-tick pulse on pin7, halt and release
